_about: What the car gains as you survive. `at` is seconds since the pursuer stood up. `id` is the rule in crates/core/src/car.rs (Kit) it switches on; `name` and `text` are what the player reads when it arrives.

upgrades.name: Roll over
upgrades.text: Hold R to roll the car back onto its wheels.

upgrades.name: Big wheels
upgrades.text: Taller, grippier wheels with more drive, for climbing out of rubble.

upgrades.name: Hover
upgrades.text: Space: float over the rubble for 3 seconds.

upgrades.name: Wings
upgrades.text: F: fly for 5 seconds. W dives, S climbs, A and D bank.
